title: Parabolic intersections in Artin groups
summary: We prove that every intersection of parabolic subgroups of any finite-rank Artin group, with arbitrary finite or infinite Coxeter labels, is parabolic. This resolves the Parabolic Intersection Conjecture affirmatively.
family_title: Classifying spaces and geometric obstructions for Artin groups

review.reason: Proves that intersections of parabolic subgroups of Artin groups are parabolic, resolving a conjecture.
